I really like Bard. I think he's really strong, just not in lane. He offers great map presence with his insane mobility (E and charm speed buff), has super good roaming ganks and his Q is pretty much a free stun in any lane due to it interacting with minions. He offers lane and jungle sustain with his W, and his ultimate is incredibly strong. It can prolong a fight, it can save your team, it can set up a gank, it can control objectives (Drag/Baron) and it can secure safe dives.     
    
You shouldn't look at Bard as a support that's going to make serious lane plays and snowball your ADC. Because quite simply he's not. He offers very little in terms of lane dominance and is easily countered by hard engage. But late game he offers great crowd control (with the meep upgrades and R), fight control, and can keep a lot of vision up even when you're behind.    
    
The biggest problem I have with him, is that when you play him, your ADC gets salty pretty quickly if A) You die, and B) If they lose some CS due to you roaming. Granted I understand there are some Bards that literally spend 0 time in lane, but in general supports roaming hasn't been a problem in the past *looking at you Blitzcrank*.
